Frontend: Header updates to show '🌍 Thai' after cuisine change
Frontend: User can type 'craving Mexican' and orange cuisine change card appears
Frontend: 'Show Mexican Recipes' button is displayed correctly
Frontend: Header updates to show '🌍 Mexican' after cuisine change
Frontend: detectCuisineFromText function correctly detects cuisine keywords (thai, mexican, italian, indian, japanese, chinese, etc.)
Frontend: Cuisine change indicators work ('switch to', 'craving', 'want some', 'how about', etc.)
Frontend: Combined mood + cuisine change request is processed (e.g., 'I'm feeling cozy and want some Japanese food')

getRecipesForNewCuisine function (lines 537-540) fetches new recipes for the selected cuisine
